node.title: Re: Mass Class Confusion - Who calls what how?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [mod://HTTP::Server::Simple] is nice for prototyping and testing out lower-level stuff. However, I would recommend against it for anything resembling production. I realize it's a lot to ask to switch after one has already started working with one module, but I would strongly recommend you look at alternatives, like at the very least [mod://Plack], or even better, [mod://Mojolicious::Lite] (see [mod://Mojolicious::Guides::Tutorial]).
